blocks.text: Each application for an alarm business license, whether new application, renewal, or as a result of revocation, shall be accompanied by the annual fee specified in TMC 5.10.190 , which shall not be refundable. (Ord. 18181 § 6, 3-2-04. Code 1995 § 30-454.)
